gui_guide_text:
1. Project: choose "Improve an existing plugin" (pick it in the list, it covers every QGIS profile), "Start a NEW plugin" (type a name) or "Any folder".
2. Press "Prepare for debugging" (new plugin: "Create and prepare") and wait until the log says "Setup complete".
   (New plugin: starter files first. Then a .venv, debugpy, the VS Code settings. Once per plugin.)
3. Press "Open in VS Code".
4. In QGIS: Plugins > DevBridge > Control Panel > "VS Code" > "Start Debug Bridge (VS Code)".
   (If DevBridge is not in QGIS yet: press "Install / enable in my QGIS profile" here, then restart QGIS.)
5. In VS Code: Ctrl+Shift+D > "PyQGIS: Attach to running QGIS" > green triangle.
6. Set a breakpoint (click left of a line number) and use your plugin in QGIS. QGIS pauses on that line.

For PyCharm: start a "Python Debug Server" run configuration in PyCharm first (port from the settings above), then in QGIS use Control Panel > "PyCharm" > "Auto-configure & Start PyCharm Bridge".

Settings here (language, ports) are shared with the QGIS plugin. Press "Save settings" to store them.
